descriptions.text: This vulnerability is associated with the burning shares functionality burn(address to) of the strategy contract which is responsible for burning the strategy tokens and allowing the user to withdraw the LP tokens. Vulnerable code snippet: https://arbiscan.io/address/0x3b4ffd93ce5fcf97e61aa8275ec241c76cc01a47 Attack tx: https://arbiscan.io/tx/0x6caa65b3fc5c8d4c7104574c3a15cd6208f742f9ada7d81ba027b20473137705 Analysis: https://medium.com/immunefi/yield-protocol-logic-error-bugfix-review-7b86741e6f50

A hacker stole approximately $181,000 worth of crypto assets from Yield’s strategic contracts present on the Arbitrum blockchain. The hacker exploited a discrepancy between the pool token balance and total supply with flash-loaned assets and then withdrew extra pool tokens.

On 30 April 2024, the defunct Yield Protocol was exploited on Arbitrum, resulting in losses of about $181,000. The attacker abused a flaw in the strategy contract's share accounting, enabling extraction of extra tokens by direct pool-token transfers, despite the protocol's prior shutdown. The attacked strategy contract calculated pool token redemption amounts based on its actual token balance instead of tracking internal accounting, allowing an attacker to inflating withdrawable value by transferring tokens directly to the contract before burning shares.
